title: Purpose of Prayer
content: Praying is done to seek help on a long journey. One's own abilities are insufficient to achieve worldly dreams, hence seeking help from the universe. The act of praying itself alters one's perspective, shifting from 'I can do it alone' to 'I might need help from the universe.'
raw_text:
But why praying? Cause this is a long journey. We ourselves is not able to achieve the things in this world (dream) then how would we alone be able to walk this journey of truth. So we ask for help.

But asking for help to sun, will sun actually help?. We don't know but the act of praying itself is what matters. Not because praying will change sun to help you. But because praying will change your perspective of you. Perspective, ego. That I can do it alone it will change it to I might need help. And I am getting help from universe.
